newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's unit to target eastern Europe reinsurance.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's unit to target eastern Europe reinsurance.

text.p: A Lloyd's underwriting consortium said on Tuesday it was setting up an operation to target reinsurance from central and eastern Europe.
Underwriting agency AE Grant is forming Central and Eastern European Reinsurance Services(CERES) in what it described as a long-term investment in the region.
Managing director David Wansbrough-Jones said that the London insurance market's recent neglect of the region had overlooked attractive prospects.

"Total reinsurance premiums emanating from the 27 countries of Central and Eastern Europe have increased four-fold over the last six years. However, the Lloyd's market share of the total is a quarter of what it was at the beginning of the period," he said.
Both Wansbrough-Jones and CERES chairman Chris Ridgwell were formerly with Allstate Re, whose business was taken over by French reinsurer Scor last year.
